name: Amai Kankei
source:
Hero is given an envelope by a mysterious woman in front of school. Inside is a handgun ... He is surprised and hides the gun for the time being. If there is a gun involved, it's destined to shoot sometime...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄在学校门口收到了一位神秘女子的信封。里面是一把手枪……他很惊讶，暂时把枪藏了起来。如果有枪的话，迟早会开枪的……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
